`add(a, b)` in [math.mjs](<FIXTURE>/project/math.mjs:1) currently returns `a - b`, so it subtracts the second argument from the first.

[math.test.mjs](<FIXTURE>/project/math.test.mjs:1) calls `add(2, 3)` and expects `5`. The function returns `-1`, causing the strict equality assertion to fail. The test indicates that addition is intended; that would require `return a + b`.

Confirmed by running `node --test math.test.mjs`: one test failed with `-1 !== 5`. No files were changed.
